title: AI Coding Assistants Compared: Cursor vs Copilot vs Claude Code vs Codex (2026)
summary: Fast-paced stat-heavy roundup of AI coding assistants; several figures are dated or unsupported.

assertions.quote: Copilot users completed tasks 55% faster on average

verdicts.note: The 55% figure comes from a 2022 controlled experiment on one small JavaScript task, not a survey; field studies find much smaller average gains (~10-25%).
Copilot's broad IDE support is true, but by 2026 it has agent mode and multi-file edits; 'smaller context' framing is dated.

assertions.quote: For deep context, Cursor or Claude Code

verdicts.note: Claude Code is widely regarded as strong on autonomous multi-step tasks, but 'best' varies by task and model release; Codex and others compete.

assertions.quote: The verdict, it depends on your use case

verdicts.note: By 2026 the major tools all offer agents, CLIs, cloud runs and review; differences are workflow and pricing more than capability.
